assets.description: OLS regression solver with Gauss-Jordan matrix inversion, t-distribution CDF, F-statistic computation. Supabase edge function that runs neighborhood-scoped calibration against qualified sales.

VEI data hooks: study period management, assessment ratio tier grouping with median calculation, appeals-by-tier analysis, and sample size tracking.
